title: American Society of Civil Engineers Maine Section
text:
Any graduating high school senior who is a Maine resident and intends to study civil engineering is eligible to apply for this <dollar/>2,000 scholarship. The award is based on academic performance, extracurricular activities, and a statement of interest in civil engineering. Applications are available from high school guidance offices and by writing:

Leslie L. Corrow, P.E.

American Society of Civil Engineers Maine Section, Scholarship Chair
